note: 도상 아트디렉션 v1. 한국에는 도리야마 세키엔 같은 퍼블릭도메인 요괴 도감 판화가 없어 전량 신규 제작한다. 600장을 찍어도 화풍이 흔들리지 않도록 스타일 블록을 문자 그대로 고정하고, 개체별 서술만 갈아 끼운다. 특정 작가의 화풍을 모사하지 않으며, 생성물임을 사이트에 명시한다.
style: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting, brush ink outline with mineral pigment wash on aged hanji mulberry paper, flat frontal perspective, visible paper fiber texture, muted dancheong palette of vermilion ochre jade-green indigo and ink black on warm off-white paper, generous negative space

composition.plate: single subject centered, full figure, plain hanji background, soft edge vignette, museum encyclopedia plate
composition.scene: wide landscape band, horizon low, layered mist planes, small figures for scale

constraints: no text, no letters, no calligraphy, no signature, no seal stamp, no watermark, no border frame, not Japanese ukiyo-e, not anime, not photorealistic, not 3d render

category_modifiers.dokkaebi: earthy ochre and vermilion accents, playful posture
category_modifiers.gataek: warm domestic tones, household objects as attributes
category_modifiers.animal: deep crimson accents, animal form mid-transformation
category_modifiers.water: indigo and jade wash, flowing water motifs
category_modifiers.mountain: green and ink wash, layered mountain silhouettes
category_modifiers.ghost: pale violet-grey wash, white mourning robe, thin ink lines
category_modifiers.plague: muted red ochre, ritual offering objects
category_modifiers.jeju: gold ochre and basalt grey, volcanic island motifs, shamanic textile patterns
category_modifiers.village: moss green and weathered wood tones, roadside shrine motifs
category_modifiers.sky: deep indigo night ground, cloud and flame motifs
category_modifiers.artifact: aged gold and brown, worn household tool as the figure
category_modifiers.hybrid: magenta and jade, two natures in one figure
category_modifiers.modern: cool slate grey, contemporary silhouette rendered in the same minhwa technique
category_modifiers.foreign: violet and gold, Buddhist temple guardian conventions
